_readme: A TEMPLATE with invented data. Copy it OUTSIDE the repository (for example ~/knowledge-eval/questions.json), replace every entry with a real question, and run: npm run eval:knowledge -- ~/knowledge-eval/questions.json. Do not commit real questions: they are workplace material. See docs/PLAN-open-work.md K1.

questions.question: What did we decide about the billing migration cutover date?
What is the status of PLAT-4421?
What has Priya raised about on-call load in the last three months?
What was the outcome of the vendor security audit?

_answers: Optional, for the answer metrics (src/eval/answers.ts): expectClaims (words from the reviewed claims a good answer cites), staleClaims (words from claims since superseded, which must not be cited as current), expectStatus (supported, conflicting or insufficient) and asOf (YYYY-MM-DD). The extraction acceptance rate needs no questions.
